card.name: Just before the word syringe
card.fires_on: The word or piece right before an expected "syringe" or "tube", such as mL after a syringe size, or "a" after "draw blood into". It appears in supply lists and preparation steps.

modes.label: Syringe size unit
modes.description: The unit mL or L after a number, just before the word syringe.
modes.example: draw 1 mL of KYBELLA into a sterile 1<< mL>> syringe and expel any air

modes.label: Draw blood into a
modes.description: The article after "into" when blood is drawn into a syringe or tube.
modes.example: Draw 4 to 5 mL of blood into<< a>> heparinized syringe.

modes.label: Partway through container words
modes.description: The middle of words like heparinized or vial, where a container noun comes next.
modes.example: discard any remaining solution in the<< v>>ial.

card.writes: It seems to push toward device-related words such as insert and cap, though the output effect is weak.
card.plain: It lights up when the text is about to name a syringe or tube, such as after "1 mL" or "blood into a".
